claims.claim: Wooden pallets are the backbone of supply chain logistics, manufacturing, and warehousing
claims.evidence: Generic marketing statement, not a factual claim about this specific item; no photo can confirm or deny it.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added
claims.evidence: Photos 0-1 show clean new-looking pallets, but Photo 2 shows weathered, stained pallets outdoors; unclear which batch is for sale, so cleanliness/dryness of the actual sold lot cannot be confirmed.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning
claims.evidence: No scale, receipt, or weighing photo/video provided; weight claim rests only on seller's text.

risks.risk: Mismatch between new pallets (Photo 0/1) and old weathered pallets (Photo 2) — unclear which is actually being sold
risks.proof: A clear photo or video of the exact batch/stack being offered for sale, labeled or counted
risks.if_unproven: price as the worse condition shown (weathered/used pallets)

risks.risk: Unknown wood treatment (heat-treated/kiln-dried vs untreated), which affects compliance and value for export/industrial use
risks.proof: Close-up photo of IPPC/HT stamp or treatment certificate on the pallet blocks

risks.risk: Unknown exact dimensions and load rating, affecting usability for standard logistics
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure against the pallet, or a spec sheet
Wide shot or video showing the full stack/lot being sold with a visible count
risks.if_unproven: price per single unit, not bulk lot

risks.risk: Hidden structural defects (cracked boards, protruding nails, missing slats) not visible in current angles
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each pallet's underside, corners, and nail points

risks.risk: Weight claim (500 kg) cannot be tied to the actual lot being sold
risks.proof: Video of the pallets being placed on a scale showing the reading in real time
risks.if_unproven: ignore weight claim for pricing; price by visual condition only

proof_requests: Wide-angle photo or video of the exact pallets being sold, with a count of units
Close-up of any treatment stamp (HT/KD) on the pallet blocks
Photo with a tape measure showing pallet dimensions
Video of pallets being weighed on a scale with reading visible
Close-up shots of undersides and corners for damage/nails
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is wooden pallets, but the photos show inconsistent condition (new vs weathered) and the seller's claims about cleanliness and weight are unverifiable, so it must be priced at the worst-case (used/weathered, unverified weight) condition until proof is provided.
